items.t: Automatic transmission slips or loses reverse
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4L60-E automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $1,300 for repairs on 2001 trucks; a full rebuild costs more.

items.t: Intake manifold gaskets leak coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Add an oil change if coolant got into the oil.

items.t: Rough running from the central 'spider' fuel injector
items.job: Replace central (spider) fuel injector assembly

items.t: Fuel pump fails and engine won't start
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module and fuel filter

items.t: Front ball joints wear out
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints (both sides) and align

items.t: ABS light on from failed brake control module
items.job: Replace or rebuild ABS electronic brake control module
items.note: A wheel speed sensor costs far less if that is the cause.

items.t: Misfire from worn distributor cap and rotor
items.job: Replace distributor cap, rotor and spark plug wires

items.t: Dashboard gauges stick or stop working
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster or replace gauge motors

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sender or pump module

items.t: Air conditioning stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, accumulator and recharge
items.note: Owners report about $2,000 on average when several parts were replaced. A simple leak repair costs much less.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hub fails
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Four-wheel drive won't engage or clunks out
items.job: Replace front axle actuator or transfer case shift motor

items.t: Brakes pulsate from warped front rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Heater fan works only on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor (and motor if worn)

items.t: Oil pressure gauge drops or jumps around
items.job: Replace oil pressure sender

items.t: Doors sag and are hard to close
items.job: Replace door hinge pins and bushings (one door)

items.t: Long crank before the engine starts
items.job: Fuel pressure leak-down test and repair
items.note: The cost depends on whether the spider injector or the fuel pump check valve is leaking.

items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
